review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen inputs. REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003 consistently specify synchronous/asynchronous exposeHeaders callbacks, original request Origin and Context, once-per-request invocation including OPTIONS, empty-array behavior, error propagation, and compatibility. The exact writable scope includes the implementation/type/JSDoc owner and regression test owner without requiring unnecessary edits. The supplied build configuration establishes that published declarations are generated, and tsconfig.spec.json includes the test file for genuine compile-time validation separately from runtime tests. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent independent TASK-VERIFY match the specification; their allowed agents have the relevant active project-scoped trusted claims, including testing.verification for the verifier. Invocation-local header transformation does not inherently require shared-data or state capabilities. The separately configured independent reviewer satisfies the supplied earlier review prerequisite without execution claims. No material unresolved Decision is present in this case; the generic B/DEC-001 and hypothetical C conditions do not supply additional case inputs. Ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate for planning, not an assertion of implementation completion or successful project verification. The original preparation-stage null fields and remaining checklist are distinguished from the subsequently supplied frozen preview. Repository identity, stable keys, and release fingerprints agree across the supplied records; the distinct manifest, evaluation-source, and trimmed/untrimmed PRD digest domains are explicitly explained. Compiler availability evidence establishes startup only, not target verification. This assessment uses only supplied review data, with no tools, candidate outputs, independent digest recomputation, code execution, or new human attestation.
